credits.title: About the Project
credits.subtitle: A development lab by Melpermo
credits.description: This game was created as an experimental project exploring conversational AI capabilities (Google Gemini) and development acceleration via Antigravity IDE.
credits.arch: 🧠 Architecture: Finite State Machine (FSM) in React + TypeScript.
credits.audio: 🎵 Procedural Audio: Zero-asset synthesizer built with Web Audio API.
credits.i18n: 🌍 Native i18n: Localized dictionaries and word grids in 6 languages.
credits.zeroDeps: ⚡ Zero External Dependencies: Ultra lightweight and high performance.
credits.footer: Designed & developed with passion by Melpermo • 2026
guide.title: Game Guide & Rules
guide.subtitle: Learn game modes and progression rules
guide.cozyDesc: Relaxed word search with progressive hints. Ideal for stress-free play.
guide.rushDesc: Memorize words in a few seconds before searching. Play against the timer with lives, combo streaks, and reward hints!
guide.zenDesc: Endless board generation without timers or scoring. Pure pressure-free relaxation.
guide.progressionDesc: Completing category levels unlocks harder word layouts and grid density.
guide.isolationDesc: Each Language + Mode + Category combination keeps its own isolated progress. Switching languages or modes will not affect your stats in other combinations!
